hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: A bonding curve launchpad hook for Uniswap v4 that manages token launches with a custom AMM curve. Enforces a 2% wallet cap with auto-refund, applies a decaying anti-snipe fee on buys, collects quote-denominated fees, and automatically graduates to a standard full-range pool (setting a fixed LP fee via updateDynamicLPFee) when the curve is completed.
